## Remarks

On the wire every object is a control record and user records travel in a `{"record": {…}}` envelope. Numbers encode as doubles, because a plain number carries no evidence of being an integer. The SDK schema accepts any value; encoding decides what can be represented (functions, symbols, bigints, circular structures, and class instances other than `Date` and arrays cannot).
